translations.web: “Remember, now, whoever perished, being innocent? Or where were the upright cut off?
translations.bsb: Consider now, I plead: Who, being innocent, has ever perished? Or where have the upright been destroyed?
translations.kjv: Remember, I pray thee, who ever perished, being innocent? or where were the righteous cut off?
